lobby.title: ◆ MULTIPLAYER
lobby.pitch: Play with your friends: each runs their own game in the same sector. You cross paths, your trades move each other's prices, and the richest wins.
lobby.name: Your nickname
lobby.sync: Synchronized days: everyone waits for the others at the end of their day
lobby.serverHint: Room server address. Locally: run "npm run server" on the machine serving the game.
lobby.shareSync: Give this code to your friends. They can join until someone finishes their first day.
lobby.shareFree: Give this code to your friends. They can join at any time.
lobby.chooseClass: Pick your class below and start whenever you like: everyone plays their own run.
lobby.finished: Your game in this room is over. The next one will be played solo.
